name: Elemental Endurance (Combat)
body:
Benefit(s): Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain energy resistance to the chosen energy type equal to your damage reduction.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different energy type.
